executionPolicy.antiLoopRule: Reject work unless it verifies a missing exit criterion, removes a named completion blocker, or safely advances beyond a deferred true human gate.
executionPolicy.waveSuccessRule: A wave is productive only if it verifies an exit criterion, clears a gate, integrates an exact-SHA candidate, emits a receipt, closes a macrocycle, or advances the execution cursor past a true human gate.
executionPolicy.blockedProjectRule: A true human gate blocks only its exact sensitive action and strictly dependent work; it is persisted to pendingHumanGates and never stops the project scheduler or other enabled projects.
executionPolicy.fanOutRule: Dispatch closure work independently for every enabled project and continue safe work even when one or more human gates are pending.

active.title: Offline, resilienza e sincronizzazione
active.outcome: Core journeys survive connectivity loss and reconcile safely.

exitCriteria.description: Core workout, readiness, feedback and progress writes can be queued durably while offline with authenticated user, source version and causal identity preserved.
Reconnect synchronization is idempotent and deterministic, rejects stale or conflicting unsafe mutations, and cannot duplicate sessions, feedback or progression evidence.
Offline and recovery states are explicit to the user; safety-critical decisions fail closed when required evidence is unavailable or unresolved.
Product CI, independent review, realistic offline/reconnect Robot journey, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

The operator journey supports customer search/create, reservation lifecycle and follow-up with explicit pending/completed/cancelled/exception states.
Product CI, independent review, PFarma customer/reservation/CRM Robot plus required cumulative simulation, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

active.title: Family Node e sincronizzazione dispositivi
active.outcome: Authorized nodes synchronize durable state without duplication.

exitCriteria.description: Authorized family nodes have durable identities, scoped credentials and synchronization cursors bound to the family and device lifecycle.
Media, metadata and organization changes synchronize incrementally and idempotently with checksums/version identity, without duplicating or orphaning canonical objects.
Interrupted, retried and concurrent node synchronization resumes from durable checkpoints and fails closed on unauthorized, corrupt or causally ambiguous changes.
Node availability, lag, failures and reconciliation state are explicit and do not leak inaccessible family metadata across authorization boundaries.
Product CI, independent review, realistic multi-node synchronization Robot journey, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

transitionRule: Certified completion activates the next macrocycle immediately. A true human gate keeps its macrocycle OPEN as DEFERRED_HUMAN_GATE in pendingHumanGates but also advances the execution cursor so autonomous independent work never stops.
reconciliationRule: Before every wave, replace stale PR, SHA, integration, completion and human-gate fields using live GitHub evidence and commit ancestry; revisit pending human gates on every trigger.
